content:
IVX HOLDINGS — CURRENT PRIORITY ORDER

Do not begin new features.

PRIORITY 1:
Verify the current Render production deployment:
- Live status
- Deployment ID
- Commit SHA
- No crash or restart loop
- Correct PORT
- /health HTTP 200
- Supabase and database connected

PRIORITY 2:
Run end-to-end production QA:
- Owner login
- Logout/login
- Session persistence
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Reels
- Chat
- Landing registration
- Supabase data synchronization

PRIORITY 3:
Secure deployment control:
- Regenerate the exposed Render deploy hook
- Store the replacement in protected variables
- Only Release Manager AI may deploy
- Block direct deployments by all other agents
- Verify GitHub HEAD = Render commit = /health commit

PRIORITY 4:
Generate the complete Expo Android APK only after production QA passes.
Then complete physical-device testing and generate the AAB.

Return a PASS/FAIL evidence table with:
- GitHub SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Health response
- Database status
- Module QA results
- APK build ID
- Remaining blockers

Do not report COMPLETE without live evidence.
